card.name: Toumblak
card.tagline: Joyful gwoka rhythm of love, fertility and celebration.
card.profile: Toumblak is among the best-known of the seven gwoka rhythms, a lively, festive rhythm associated with love, fertility, joy and the earth, generating sensual, undulating hip movements and suggestive postures. A faster, accelerated variant is called toumblak chire. Played on the ka drums (two boula plus make soloist) with chacha and responsorial Creole song, it is danced in the lawonn circle during lewoz gatherings and is often compared to African fertility dances such as the kalenda (Wikipedia: Gwo ka; Comite du Tourisme des Iles de Guadeloupe).
card.insight: Toumblak is frequently described as the most famous and widespread gwoka rhythm, embodying celebration and courtship amid the hardship of enslaved life.
